title: The way you are, right now
text: I love you for who you are today. Not for some future version of you I imagine, but for the person you actually are — with all the things that make you you.

title: Your kindness
text: There is a gentleness in the way you treat people that I really love. It is one of those things about you that feels natural rather than performed.

title: How playful you can be
text: I love the playful side of you — the little jokes, teasing, random moments and the way you can make an ordinary conversation feel fun.

title: Our conversations
text: I love how easily we can keep talking. Sometimes it is something important, sometimes it is completely pointless, and somehow I enjoy both.

title: The little touches
text: I love the small physical moments between us. A touch, sitting close, holding hands — things that barely take a second but somehow stay with me.

title: How openly you care
text: I love that you are not afraid to let the people around you know about the people and things that matter to you. There is something warm about that openness.

title: The person behind everything
text: Beyond the things I can list, I just love the person I get to know more every day. The habits, expressions, moods, jokes and little imperfections are all part of the person I chose.

title: You make things feel like memories
text: I love how even simple moments with you can become something I want to remember. Sometimes nothing special happens — and I still find myself wanting to keep the moment.

title: The way you treat me like a kid
text: She treats me like a kid wherever possible and takes care of me.

title: The reassurance you need
text: The feeling that you want to assure that I genuinely love you and would accompany her throught her lifetime by asking silly questions gets me feel valued and loved.

title: The way you get irritated with me
text: I love teasing you until you get completely irritated with me, only to follow you around apologising while you make me work for your forgiveness. And just when you've taken away my last bit of peace, you burst out laughing, making the whole thing worth it.

title: The plans you make with me
text: Even with your studies, hostel life, and everything else you have to manage, you still make plans for all the places you want us to explore together. I love knowing that, in the middle of your busy life, you still make room for adventures with me.

title: When you let me see your vulnerable side
text: I love the moments when you let your guard down and share your tears and emotions with me. Being able to hold you close, comfort you, and stand beside you through your hardest moments makes me feel grateful for the trust you place in me.

title: Your little acts of mischief
text: I love how you playfully hit me, bite me, and tease me, only to soften up and pat my face when I tell you it hurt. That little switch from mischief to tenderness is such a uniquely you thing, and I adore it.

title: The way you want our future together
text: I love how you keep imagining places we could visit and experiences we could share, even with so much on your shoulders. Your plans make me feel that I'm not just part of your present, but someone you genuinely want beside you as we make more memories together.
